# Simple Graphs

This document contains code to generate some simple figures.

## Requierments

Run the code chunk below to load in all needed packages.

```{r}
pacman::p_load(
  conflicted,
  tidyverse,
  wrappedtools,
  randomNames
)
conflict_scout()
conflicts_prefer(
  dplyr::filter,
  stats::lag
)
```

## Bar plots

This code can be used to generate some bar plots.

```{r}
# Generate some random data to fill the plot
set.seed(314156)
sample = c("ctrl", "ctrl", "ctrl", "ctrl")
ctrl <- rnorm(n = 5, mean = 1, sd = 0.2)
mut1 <- rnorm(n = 5, mean = 1, sd = 0.25)
mut2 <- rnorm(n = 5, mean = 1.6, sd = 0.3)

rawdata <- tibble(
  ctrl = ctrl,
  mut1 = mut1,
  mut2 = mut2
)

ggplot(rawdata, aes(x = ctrl)) + geom_bar()
```
